verdict.rationale: Alacritty is a local desktop terminal emulator with no web service or HTTP API, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this kind of product. Its only programmatic surface is local IPC via `alacritty msg`, and nothing in the evidence shows a machine-readable spec for it. The 404 probe results for openapi.json and similar paths are consistent with there being no web API at all.
